name: tpl-existence-two-3-goal
task: Be holding the key on at least two different moves, open the door and reach the goal.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The hard Existence(door_open) clause is redundant because the other hard rules (ExistenceTwo(has_key), Precedence(door_open, at_goal), Existence(at_goal)) already enforce that the door must be opened before reaching the goal. Remove the redundant Existence(door_open) clause; the remaining clauses correctly capture the task.

CHANGES REQUIRED: The clause `Existence(door_open)` is redundant, as every run that satisfies the other hard rules already guarantees that the door will be opened. Remove this clause (keep `ExistenceTwo(has_key)`, `Precedence(door_open, at_goal)`, and `Existence(at_goal)`).

CHANGES REQUIRED: The task requires the agent to open the door (door_open must occur). The current clauses do not ensure door_open, only that the goal cannot precede it. Add a hard Existence(door_open) clause to guarantee the door is opened before reaching the goal.

CHANGES REQUIRED: The clause "The agent must open the door at some point" (hard Existence(door_open)) is redundant, because every satisfying run already has door_open true due to the hard Precedence(door_open, at_goal) together with the hard Existence(at_goal). Remove the redundant Existence(door_open) clause; keep the other three clauses unchanged.
